use_case: Face match alerts at the Property A front entrance after hours: compares a face captured by the reader camera at each after-hours credential use with the holder's badge photo and alerts the Property Manager on a mismatch (the door still opens)
vendor_or_model: Access control and video platform vendor (face recognition model; platform feature)
data_categories: Face images and face templates from badge photos (about 190 holders) and from entrance video frames; credential holder names; after-hours door events
consequential_decision_category: None (alert only); becomes Safety/CI if a mismatch could deny entry or lock a door
human_in_the_loop: Property Manager reviewed every alert against video before any action; no automatic door action
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. 45(a)) and the FTC biometric policy statement (2023-05-18); Fla. Stat. 501.171 (templates treated as biometric personal information; whether the 501.702 exclusion for data generated from video or photographs applies is unsettled, counsel to confirm); lease terms on the use of badge photos
status: Retired: trial 2026-06-08 to 2026-07-24; not approved (P10 decision 2026-08-31); vendor deletion of templates requested

use_case: Person detection alerts on the Property B rear corridor and parking cameras after hours (19:00 to 7:00): alerts the Property Manager with a clip when a person is detected
vendor_or_model: Access control and video platform vendor (person detection model; platform feature)
data_categories: Video of people at the rear corridor and parking lot; alert clips (no identity inferred; no face templates)
human_in_the_loop: Property Manager watches the clip and decides whether to call the on-call guard or police; no automatic action
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (accurate signage and notice); Fla. Stat. 934.03 (audio stays off)
status: In production since 2024; approved with conditions (clips kept 30 days; signs updated; no face features)
